news.title: Iran live updates: U.S. and Israel launch strikes, Trump dubs attack 'Operation Epic Fury'
news.description: Iran retaliated with strikes across the Middle East. Travel across the region is disrupted.

news.title: How the attack on Iran could impact the global oil market and economy
news.description: The U.S.-Israeli attack raises the risk of major oil supply disruption. Iran is the fourth-largest OPEC producer and sits on the critical Strait of Hormuz.

news.title: Berkshire Hathaway operating earnings fell nearly 30% in Warren Buffett's final quarter as CEO
news.description: Berkshire Hathaway reported fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 earnings on Saturday.
